title: MARS: Modality-Aligned Retrieval for Sequence Augmented CTR Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2509.01184v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction serves as a cornerstone of recommender systems. Despite the strong performance of current CTR models based on user behavior modeling, they are still severely limited by interaction sparsity, especially in low-active user scenarios. To address this issue, data augmentation of user behavior is a promising research direction. However, existing data augmentation methods heavily rely on collaborative signals while overlooking the rich multimodal features of items, leading to insufficient modeling of low-active users. translated_title: MARS：面向序列增强CTR预测的模态对齐检索
translated_abstract: 点击率（CTR）预测是推荐系统的基石。尽管当前基于用户行为建模的CTR模型表现出强大的性能，但它们仍然严重受限于交互稀疏性问题，尤其是在低活跃用户场景中。为了解决这一问题，用户行为数据增强是一个有前景的研究方向。然而，现有的数据增强方法严重依赖协同信号，而忽视了物品丰富的多模态特征，导致对低活跃用户的建模不足。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了一个新颖的框架MARS（面向序列增强CTR预测的模态对齐检索）。MARS利用基于Stein核的方法将文本和图像特征对齐到统一且无偏的语义空间中，以构建多模态用户嵌入。随后，每个低活跃用户的行为序列（摘要内容不完整，后续部分被截断）
tldr: 提出了MARS框架，通过基于Stein核的方法将文本和图像特征对齐到统一无偏的语义空间，构建多模态用户嵌入以增强低活跃用户的行为序列，从而提升CTR预测性能。
en_tdlr: MARS is a novel CTR prediction framework that aligns text and image features into a unified unbiased semantic space via Stein kernels to build multimodal user embeddings, augmenting low-active users' behavior sequences for improved performance.
